slogan_en: You study people like a science. They feel seen anyway.
core_insight_en: PLACEHOLDER — Phase 2.5 will author this. Theme: Investigative-dominant + Social-supporting; rigorously curious about people without losing the warmth that makes them open up. This 80-120 word core insight will describe the IS archetype (The Empathic Investigator) with India-flavored copy, integrating Hinglish accents (Sharma ji, Aunty, EMI references) where they earn their place, and balancing the dark-humor IBTI tone with the temperature-of-warmth this cell rewards.
deep_description_en: PLACEHOLDER — Phase 2.5 will author the 300-500 word body for the IS cell (The Empathic Investigator). Theme: Investigative-dominant + Social-supporting; rigorously curious about people without losing the warmth that makes them open up. To be drafted by GPT-4o with native Indian copywriter review. The body will weave stress signals, growth edges, and identity claims ("I'm the kind of person who…") in a way that feels recognisably IS, not generic. Hinglish accents (Sharma ji, Aunty, EMI culture) appear only when they earn their place, and the dark-humor IBTI roast is balanced with a warmth temperature appropriate to this archetype — sharper for cells like EC and CE, gentler for SI and IS.
strengths_en: Synthesis of mixed signals into coherent insight
growth_tips_en: Set strict timeboxes for analysis to avoid analysis paralysis
Ship 70%-ready outputs and iterate, instead of polishing in private
Use peer rubber-ducking to externalize the overthink loop
